record.original_question: Let H be nonzero and let C be a closed curve contained in a slab S_w in R^3 of width w. If |H| < 2/w, does there exist a topological disk of constant mean curvature H that spans C and is contained in S_w?

evidence.quote: Problem 3.3 (3*). Let H != 0 and let C be a closed curve contained in a slab S_w subset R3 of width w such that |H| < 2/w. Does an H-topological disk exist spanning C and included in S_w?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S_w \subset \mathbb{R}^3$ denote a closed slab of width $w > 0$, that is, a region bounded by two parallel planes at distance $w$ apart. Let $H \in \mathbb{R}$ be a nonzero constant with $|H| < 2/w$, and let $C \subset S_w$ be a simple closed (Jordan) curve contained in the slab. An $H$-topological disk spanning $C$ is an immersed surface $\Sigma \subset \mathbb{R}^3$ homeomorphic to the closed $2$-disk, whose boundary $\partial \Sigma = C$, and which has constant mean curvature equal to $H$.

Question: Under the above hypotheses, does there always exist an $H$-topological disk $\Sigma$ that spans $C$ and is contained entirely in the slab $S_w$?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open question concerning existence of constant mean curvature disks confined to a slab, related to known slab-width estimates of Meeks–Tinaglia (every embedded H-disk in R^3 lies in a slab of width at most a constant times 1/|H|). Web search did not surface a published resolution; existing literature provides only related radius and slab-width estimates rather than a general spanning-existence theorem under |H| < 2/w.

status_evidence.title: Constant mean curvature surfaces (Survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Every H-disk in R^3 has radius less than R/H for some universal R; embedded H-disks lie in slabs of width comparable to 1/|H|.
status_evidence.claim: Related slab-width and radius estimates are known, but a general existence statement of the requested form is not established.

status_evidence.title: The topology and geometry of embedded surfaces of constant mean curvature
status_evidence.snippet: Studies topology of CMC surfaces with planar boundary, including disk-type characterizations.
status_evidence.claim: Background context for CMC disks with prescribed boundary; does not resolve the slab existence question.
